description: A row of dancers joined hand to hand, facing alternately, rocks forward and back.

walkthrough.line: In your wave, rock forward together on the first beat and back on the third.
walkthrough.teach: You are in a wave: give your {hand} hand to the dancer one place along the set and your other hand to the one behind you, so every hand along the row is joined and the dancers beside you look the other way. Rock forward together, then rock back, and stay on your own place.
